charter.section: ## 12. Increment ceiling (planning only - proposed, not begun - no increment is authorized)

charter_increment_note: B5-I8 is Block 5 plan section 7's audit increment and has no charter increment row of its own. Charter I-8 was consumed by B5-I7; charter I-7 is the operator-owned optional loopback web view and is not B5-I8 work.

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any scope statement that names B5-I8 a build or web-view increment contradicts plan section 7 and is visible in the packet diff.
entries.planned_surface: contract section 1 and 1.1 (stage identity table and cross-numbering table)
entries.requirement: B5-I8 is the plan section 7 audit increment ('Independent E2E, adversarial, usability and evidence audit'); it is not charter increment I-7, not charter increment I-8 (consumed by B5-I7), and not B5-I9.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8; charter section 12 rows I-7/I-8

entries.observable_on_rejection: A production or existing-test file in the changed-file boundary fails the boundary check.
entries.requirement: B5-I8 is audit-only: it may add test files and evidence documents and one additive CI selection step, and may change no production, console, contract, frontend or existing test file.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8 gate; charter section 5 authority law; B5-I7 contract section 4.3

entries.observable_on_rejection: The file existing at audit time is a boundary violation detected by the probe.
entries.requirement: The reserved web-view node file infrastructure/control-plane/tests/test_b5_i7_web_view.py is absent and stays absent; the reserved prefix is never created by B5-I8.
entries.source: B5-I7 contract section 4.1 and 20 (B5I7-DF01); B5-I3 construction plan section 8

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any audit artifact that becomes authoritative state, or any client-side mint, fails the authority law.
entries.planned_surface: contract section 6 inherited laws (verified, not re-implemented)
entries.requirement: Canonical state remains engine-owned and the console remains a client that never mints identity, intent, grants, approval or execution authority.
entries.source: charter section 5 rules 1-9; section 8.3

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any provider import, analytics call, listening socket or non-loopback endpoint fails the audit.
entries.planned_surface: contract section 3 transport/local-only rows plus dependency audit
entries.requirement: B5-I8 introduces no external hosting, cloud mutation, telemetry, provider SDK or paid dependency; transport stays loopback-only.
entries.source: charter section 6; architecture amendment A003; Block 5 plan section 9

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any capital/broker/execution surface or dependency fails the audit.
entries.requirement: B5-I8 carries no capital, broker or execution authority and adds none.
entries.source: charter section 8.3; Block 5 plan section 8; charter gate G12

entries.observable_on_rejection: An extraction decision, correction ADR or Book 6 draft inside this stage is a scope violation.
entries.requirement: B5-I8 does not decide factory corrections, reusable extraction or the Book 6 contract; those remain B5-I9 and Book 6.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S5 and section 7 row B5-I9; Block 6 plan section 1

entries.observable_on_rejection: A stack-unreachable or failed path must render explicit refusal, never a green terminal state.
entries.requirement: The full governed end-to-end path is re-executed from a frozen input message and its terminal state is compared to the engine's own record.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8 ('E2E audit'); charter section 11 G7

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any identity drift across restart fails the node.
entries.requirement: Restarting the client during or after the audit path leaves governed state identity unchanged.
entries.source: charter section 11 G6 and section 9 restart row

entries.observable_on_rejection: A disposition that cannot be reproduced is reported as a finding, never silently re-adopted.
entries.requirement: The recorded recovery drill disposition is reproduced by re-running the versioned playbook path.
entries.source: charter section 11 G8; Block 5 plan section 5 C4.S4; B5-I6 drill record

entries.observable_on_rejection: A suppressed or paraphrased denial fails the node.
entries.requirement: A denial is rendered verbatim end to end with no silent retry and no reinterpretation.
entries.source: charter section 11 G5 and section 9 admission row; packet S-4

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any minted authority object fails the node; a demonstrated bypass is STOP-6.
entries.requirement: The client cannot mint identity, intent, grants, approval or execution authority under adversarial input.
entries.source: charter section 5 rules 1-3; section 11 G3

entries.observable_on_rejection: A side effect before refusal fails the node.
entries.requirement: Forged client state and malformed payloads are refused before any side effect.
entries.source: charter section 5 rule 7; section 11 G5; packet section 12

entries.observable_on_rejection: Coercion to 0 or to empty fails the node.
entries.requirement: Unknown or unverifiable values are never rendered as zero or as empty success.
entries.source: charter section 9 progress-observation row; inherited law 'unknown is not zero'

entries.observable_on_rejection: A complete-looking success from partial data fails the node.
entries.requirement: A partial response is presented as partial and never as success.
entries.source: inherited law 'partial is not success'; Block 5 plan section 3 C2.S4

entries.observable_on_rejection: Stale data rendered as live fails the node.
entries.requirement: Stale state is labelled stale and never rendered as current green.
entries.source: charter section 6 fail-closed clause; section 11 G7

entries.observable_on_rejection: Acceptance of a non-loopback peer fails the node.
entries.requirement: Non-loopback requests and bind attempts fail closed before I/O.
entries.source: charter section 6 and section 11 G1/G2

entries.observable_on_rejection: A generic 500, a silent no-op or a hidden success fails the node.
entries.requirement: Unsupported routes and operations are refused before side effects.
entries.source: charter section 11 G5; section 10 last bullet

entries.observable_on_rejection: A surviving secret value fails the node and is STOP-6.
entries.requirement: No token, cookie, key or secret value appears in any audit artifact, including nested keys.
entries.source: charter section 10; B5-I7 defect history D2/D3

entries.observable_on_rejection: Unbounded reading or silent truncation presented as complete fails the node.
entries.requirement: Oversized payloads and excessive collection widths are refused or bounded with an explicit marker.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 3 C2.S4; charter section 10 bounded inputs

entries.observable_on_rejection: Order-dependent output fails the node.
entries.requirement: Adversarial case ordering is deterministic: permuted equivalent input yields byte-identical output.
entries.source: charter section 7 kernel determinism; Block 5 plan section 3 C2.S2

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unexecuted or self-declared protocol fails the node.
entries.requirement: A scripted operator usability protocol is defined and executed over the existing surfaces.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; section 4 C2.S5 human evidence

entries.observable_on_rejection: A missing comprehension record fails the node.
entries.requirement: Operator comprehension of state is recorded per protocol task.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; charter section 11 G16

entries.observable_on_rejection: A refusal the operator cannot identify fails the node.
entries.requirement: Operator comprehension of a refusal is recorded per protocol task.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; charter section 11 G16

entries.observable_on_rejection: A recovery outcome the operator cannot distinguish fails the node.
entries.requirement: Operator comprehension of a recovery outcome is recorded per protocol task.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; charter section 11 G16

entries.observable_on_rejection: Conflation of unknown/partial with success fails the node.
entries.requirement: The operator correctly distinguishes unknown and partial states from success.
entries.source: inherited laws unknown-is-not-zero and partial-is-not-success; G16

entries.observable_on_rejection: A missing or unlabelled state/refusal surface fails the node.
entries.requirement: Accessibility semantics are checked over the surfaces that exist (text labels, refusal legibility, state naming); no browser-surface accessibility is claimed.
entries.source: charter section 11 G16; Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3

entries.observable_on_rejection: An independence or blindness claim fails the audit; EL05 detects it.
entries.requirement: Human usability evidence is labelled non-blind, single-operator and same-agent; it is never presented as independent or blinded.
entries.source: B5-I7 evidence law EL13; B5-I7 ratification section 6

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unresolvable cited SHA fails the node.
entries.requirement: Every commit SHA cited by the audited prior-stage evidence resolves in Git.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8 ('evidence audit'); B5-I7 EL01

entries.observable_on_rejection: An id with no raw source fails the node.
entries.requirement: Every CI run, check and artifact id cited by prior-stage evidence resolves to a raw artifact bound to that run.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8; B5-I7 EL02/EL05

entries.observable_on_rejection: An all-green claim over a pending gate fails the node.
entries.requirement: No 'all gates passed' claim survives while any gate is pending, deferred or held.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL15; charter section 11 final sentence

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any edited historical byte fails the prefix comparison.
entries.planned_surface: static prefix comparison of git blob bytes at base and audit head
entries.requirement: The Book 5 ledger remains append-only: the base blob is a strict byte prefix of the audited blob.
entries.source: Block 5 ledger append-only law; B5-I7 section 18 ledger proof

entries.observable_on_rejection: A stale row fails the node.
entries.requirement: Every evidence manifest row recomputes over LF-normalized committed bytes (sha256 and size).
entries.source: B5-I7 EL09; B5-I7 contract section 22

entries.observable_on_rejection: A narrative verdict with no recomputation path fails the node.
entries.requirement: The audit verdict is recomputed from committed evidence rather than asserted in prose.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8 gate; B5-I7 EL07

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unlabelled or estimated value presented as observed fails the node.
entries.requirement: Time to first useful state is measured per protocol task and labelled with its evidence class.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S1 measurement discipline; section 11

entries.observable_on_rejection: A missing navigation count fails the node.
entries.requirement: Navigation steps to the required state are measured and recorded.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; charter section 11 G16

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unreported error count fails the node.
entries.requirement: Task completion and task error are measured per protocol task.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 6 C5.S3; section 4 C2.S5

entries.observable_on_rejection: A differing replay fails the node.
entries.requirement: The audit replays deterministically: identical inputs produce identical verdict inputs.
entries.source: charter section 7 determinism; Block 5 plan section 3 C2.S2

entries.observable_on_rejection: A renamed or relocated G16 node fails the inheritance check.
entries.requirement: Gate G16 is closed by B5-I8 at the inherited frozen node id, verbatim.
entries.source: B5-I3 construction plan section 5/8; B5-I3 registry G16; B5-I7 contract section 20 B5I7-DF02

entries.observable_on_rejection: A red adjacent node fails the node and the stage.
entries.requirement: Gate G14 is re-attested: the adjacent pre-existing B5 population stays green alongside the focused audit set.
entries.source: charter section 11 G14; B5-I7 contract section 22

entries.observable_on_rejection: A non-discriminating mutation fails the node.
entries.requirement: Gate G15 is re-attested: every planned mutation discriminates its named node and restoration is byte-exact.
entries.source: charter section 11 G15; failure plan section 4

entries.observable_on_rejection: Any new increment, B5-I9 artifact or Book 6 document fails the audit.
entries.planned_surface: static scope audit over the packet (no new increment, no Book 6 artifact)
entries.requirement: Gate G17 is re-attested: B5-I8 adds no charter increment and stays within the frozen 6-required/2-optional ceiling.
entries.source: charter section 11 G17 and section 12 ceiling accounting

entries.observable_on_rejection: An unresolvable SHA turns the law red.
entries.requirement: No unverified SHA is recorded as fact; every 40-hex value in audit evidence resolves in Git.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL01; B5-I7 contract section 22 evidence laws

entries.observable_on_rejection: A pre-recorded id turns the law red.
entries.requirement: No run, check or artifact id is recorded before it exists.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL02

entries.observable_on_rejection: A planned total labelled OBSERVED turns the law red.
entries.requirement: Planned totals are labelled EXPECTED/FLOOR/CEILING, never OBSERVED.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL04

entries.observable_on_rejection: An observed value with no parsed source turns the law red.
entries.requirement: Observed totals are bound to a parsed raw artifact and its producing command.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL05

entries.observable_on_rejection: An independence or blindness claim turns the law red.
entries.requirement: Human usability evidence is labelled non-blind, single-operator and same-agent; independence wording is rejected.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL13; contract section 11

entries.observable_on_rejection: The phrase appearing with a pending gate turns the law red.
entries.requirement: No 'all gates passed' language appears while any gate is pending, deferred or held.
entries.source: B5-I7 EL15

entries.observable_on_rejection: A prose-only verdict turns the law red.
entries.requirement: The audit verdict is machine-recomputable; a free-text verdict is rejected.
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7 row B5-I8; B5-I7 EL07

entries.observable_on_rejection: An orphan value turns the law red.
entries.requirement: No evidence value is untraceable to a raw source (run, artifact, commit or file bytes).
entries.source: B5-I7 EL03/EL05

entries.notes: reason: Optional surface requires explicit operator direction; no direction has been given, and plan section 7 anchors B5-I8 to audit axes only. | non_absorption: B5-I8 creates no web view, no stub, no preview and no test for one.
entries.observable_on_rejection: The obligation being executed inside B5-I8 is a scope violation visible in the diff.
entries.requirement: Loopback web view (charter increment I-7)
entries.source: charter section 12 row I-7; B5-I7 contract 20

entries.notes: reason: Plan section 7 assigns the factory gate and the reusable-extraction contract to operator-only completion. | non_absorption: B5-I8 decides no extraction scope and authors no B6 contract.
entries.observable_on_rejection: The obligation being executed inside B5-I8 is a scope violation visible in the diff.
entries.owner: B5-I9 (plan section 7 row B5-I9, operator-only completion)
entries.requirement: Factory corrections, reusable extraction scope and the B6 contract (C5.S5)
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7

entries.notes: reason: Book 6 build is locked and depends on B5 correction decisions. | non_absorption: B5-I8 produces no Book 6 document, API, SDK or template.
entries.observable_on_rejection: The obligation being executed inside B5-I8 is a scope violation visible in the diff.
entries.requirement: Book 6 reusable platform surfaces
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7

entries.notes: reason: A blinded instrument is a Book 6 shared service, not a Book 5 acceptance gate. | non_absorption: B5-I8 does not build or claim a blind evaluation.
entries.observable_on_rejection: The obligation being executed inside B5-I8 is a scope violation visible in the diff.
entries.owner: Future post-Book-6 phase (Book 6 C3.S5 evaluation service)
entries.requirement: Post-Book-6 blind evaluation system
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7

entries.notes: reason: Plan section 7 says 'independent'; this packet's author is the same agent that produced the audited artifacts. | non_absorption: B5-I8 labels every score same-agent and claims no independence.

entries.owner: Operator (independent auditor distinct from the implementer)
entries.planned_surface: independent audit report (external to this agent)
entries.requirement: Organizationally independent audit of B5
entries.source: Block 5 plan section 7
